names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Ευθύμιος ο Νέος», with the rank word left off. The epithet «ο Νέος» is left off the English form here because the corpus already keeps another Euthymius the New, on 15 October.
